name: Rice Terraces
desc: A terraced hillside carved into contour steps by hand over centuries — flooded paddies wrap the spurs and gullies as ribbons of held sky, dry bands carry hatched crop rows, valley mist scrolls behind the ridge and again in front of the foot, and the specular light walks slowly across the water; overcast silver, low gold hour, moonlit black mirrors, a hypsometric survey sheet, or multispectral false colour.

energy.doc: how hard the water burns — specular shimmer on the paddies and the broad light sweep

scale.doc: terrace size — big scale gives few thick steps with dramatic spur bulges, small gives a fine staircase (rebuilds the hill)

density.doc: how many terrace steps are cut into the hill

flood.doc: fraction of the terraces under water — 0 is a dry harvested hill, 1 is the whole face mirrored

mist.doc: aerial perspective — how much the far terraces and ridges dissolve

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default crop-green / silver-water pairing

x.doc: where the light stands — the specular hot zone tracks it

y.doc: ridge line height — low y gives a wall of terraces, high y opens up sky

style.doc: aesthetic: monsoon = overcast silver large-format, paddies the only bright thing; goldhour = low sun, molten water, olive-silhouette crop; nightpaddy = moonlit black mirrors, dark key; hypso = hypsometric survey sheet, elevation ramp + index contours, no water or crop; ndvi = multispectral false colour, vegetation burns magenta and water goes navy void

act.doc: multi-minute weather programme indexed off the section arc

seed.doc: regenerates the spur/gully topography and which terraces are flooded

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
